figurative_meaning_en: Waiting or expecting for a prolonged period
example_sentences_in_bangla: বসে বসে তার অপেক্ষায় ক্লান্ত হয়ে গেলাম।
বাসের জন্য বসে বসে সময় কাটালো।
example_sentences_in_english: I got tired waiting for him sitting around idly.
He passed the time sitting around waiting for the bus.
note: Commonly used to express the tedium of prolonged waiting in everyday Bengali speech.
